mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_product (category_id, name, description, cover, price, original_price, stock, sales_count, unit, status, is_hot, is_new, create_time) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, #{salesCount}, #{unit}, #{status}, #{isHot}, #{isNew}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mall_product WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, pc.name AS category_name FROM mall_product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_product SET sales_count = sales_count + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mall_product SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT pc.name as category, COUNT(*) as count FROM mall_product p JOIN product_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.category_id, pc.name ORDER BY count DESC
